dump_results: dump 3D object detection results including point clouds, predicted bounding boxes, and ground truth boxes to PLY files
softmax: compute softmax probabilities over the last dimension of a numpy array
dump_results_inference: dump prediction results only without ground truth labels for inference mode
dump_results_nms: dump predicted bounding boxes filtered by NMS mask and objectness confidence threshold
dump_results_map_cls: dump per-batch prediction and ground truth class mapping details to text files
